## Body

security: pass-with-notes (head d3ea172cf60b9c18ab463651006555e6ba8cb4f7)

Round 2, final. No remaining reportable security vulnerabilities. Both requested fixes are closed:

- **Redirect confinement:** `crates/daemon/src/cache_proxy.rs:382-425` sets `Policy::none()`, retains client-construction errors rather than falling back to an unrestricted client, and rejects non-2xx responses before decoding. The gate returns plain with no provider wiring on status failure (`:200-210`). `a_redirecting_status_route_is_not_followed` (`crates/daemon/src/cache_proxy_tests.rs:278-317`) checks a 302, plain/no wiring, and zero hits on the redirect destination.
- **Verified rollover inheritance:** native admission checks the observed Copilot executable, process incarnation and pane ancestry (`crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:505-614,692-844`). Predecessor resolution requires the same verified host incarnation/pane and a different native session (`:998-1065,1753-1794`). The route copy (`:1145-1167`) preserves only a matching spawned/unchanged incarnation or the verified same-process predecessor; an unrelated reclaim/relaunch cannot inherit a displaced process's route by seat identifier alone. The HTTP/SQLite regression checks proxied S1-to-S2 and opted-out S2-to-S3 inheritance (`crates/daemon/src/http/native_tests.rs:3151-3294,3430-3463`).

The requested `git range-diff 872fafab~4..872fafab 2d5b1a9c..d3ea172c` confirmed the four original patches were retained apart from the difficulties-ledger merge; the subsequent commits contain the scoped fixes and requirement-state corrections. The original five security checks carry forward: token-free typed status; fixed-name, discrete environment argv rather than interpolated shell text; startup-only status URL; no newly credential-bearing notice/doctor fields; and no credential or prohibited third-party disclosure in the reviewed public diff. C19/C21/C33/C34 applied.

**Evidence:** `just pr-freeze 241` passed, FINAL at the full head above, with CLEAN merge state and every latest check passing. `gh run view 44235226491 --repo AI-Substrate/pij-fleet` reports success for Node 22/24 checks, Rust lint and Rust tests. The Rust checkout log identifies synthetic merge `a569de6f2649eddf608b195d04ecab339d50ee0e` of this head into base `50ddd256a224bad407b08301463fdb9e6ef9e483`. Successful Rust job `134569619430` names artifact `14396524204`; its JUnit has 2,494 cases, zero failures/errors/skips, and passes both named regressions above.

**Notes / proof limits:** the startup URL override is trusted daemon configuration; its prefix-only validation is not a general parsed-host confinement guarantee. Status `reason`/`fix` text is not an arbitrary-secret scrubber. Native verification is registration-strength observation, not authentication against a same-user process (C33). No exploit beyond those accepted trust boundaries was established. Source/range-diff and CI receipts were inspected; author-supplied mutation/live receipts were not reproduced.
